**Risk flags:**
- Defendant in 1 case(s), total claims RM310,600  
- Director 1 holds 63.91% of shares  

**Overview:**  
Teguh Bestari Medical Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited dental clinic and orthodontic service provider operating in Sabah. Incorporated on 17 Oct 1988, it has a share capital of RM100,000 and two directors, with the largest shareholder holding 63.91% of the equity. The company reported revenues of RM1.07 million (2022), RM1.09 million (2023) and RM1.16 million (2024), with profit after tax ranging from RM80,085 to RM90,125 and unqualified audit opinions each year.
